summary: ITER29 Promotions system — backend FULLY tested via pytest (19/19 PASS): admin CRUD, summary/leaderboard/feed/participants, public /promotions/active, non-admin 403 guard, SAST timezone (+02:00) on now_sast, M/W/F seed presence, score-event integration (post_create wrote a promotion_event when 24x7 window open), and 5-endpoint regression smoke (dashboard/metrics, users-list, connections/me/summary, places, jobs) all green. Frontend source-verified: all required data-testids exist on PromotionsListPage (promotions-list-page, promotions-summary, new-promotion-button, promotion-editor-modal, promo-name/desc/start-time/end-time/min-score/zar-rate/submit, promo-day-0..6, promo-action-{name}, promo-row-/open-/toggle-/delete-{id}) and PromotionDetailPage (promotion-detail-page, promo-tab-trend/leaderboard/feed, promo-daily-trend, promo-leaderboard, promo-live-feed), and the admin-go-promotions button is on AdminMetricsDashboardPage. Playwright UI interactions were partially blocked because progressive-signup returned 403 when called from urllib inside the headless-browser runner (likely bot/UA filter on the preview ingress) — the same flow works perfectly from pytest's `requests` session, confirming this is an automation-harness artefact, not a real bug. One LATENT backend bug found in the notifier loop (will crash on first window-open transition).

minor.issue: `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` is INVALID — Motor's distinct() returns a coroutine resolving to a List, not an async iterator. Will raise TypeError the first time a promo window transitions to OPEN (the `JUST OPENED` branch). Fix: `for uid in await db.promotion_events.distinct('user_id', {'promotion_id': promo['id']}):`. Not caught by tests yet because notifier hasn't fired a transition during the run window, but it will crash the loop iter (suppressed by the broad except → logger.warning) and no notifications will be inserted.

action_items: Fix server.py:8195 — change `async for uid in db.promotion_events.distinct(...)` to `for uid in await db.promotion_events.distinct(...)`. This is the only real defect found in iter29.

(Optional, low priority) The notifier loop's `_notify_state` is read from the in-memory _PROMO_CACHE which is refreshed every 60s, but updates are written to mongo — there's a small race where the same `opened_on`/`pre_open_on` notification could be sent twice within the same minute on a multi-worker deployment. Today this app runs single-worker so it's fine.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:8195 — async-for over Motor `.distinct()` is a bug (returns coroutine→List, not async-iterable). Same pattern is correctly used at L8198-8203/8206-8208 with `db.users.find().limit().__aiter__` so the dev clearly knows the right shape; just a typo here.

server.py:8042 — `admin_promotion_leaderboard` runs an N+1 query inside a list-comprehension (`await db.users.find_one({...is_ambassador})` per row). For a leaderboard of 50 this is 50 sequential round-trips. Recommend a single `$in` lookup or a `$lookup` stage in the existing aggregate.

server.py:7873/7878-7881 — `promotion_events` doc uses both `created_at` (UTC iso) and `created_at_sast` (SAST iso) plus a `day_key` derived in SAST — good. Recommend adding a compound mongo index on `(promotion_id, created_at)` and `(promotion_id, user_id)` for the aggregate pipelines that scan all events.

server.py:7906/7950/7972 — `require_admin_user` already enforces role ∈ {admin, moderator}, so the inner `if admin.get('role') != 'admin'` checks are redundant for the admin role gate but DO usefully exclude moderators from CRUD. Worth a comment to make the intent explicit.
server.py:8264 — second `app.include_router(api_router)` (also flagged in iter31 retest) is still present. Harmless but messy.

server.py:8224-8228 / 8232-8259 — two separate @app.on_event('startup') handlers (iter29_start_promo_loop + iter29_seed_mwf_promotion). FastAPI's @on_event is deprecated; consider consolidating into a `lifespan` context manager.
PromotionsListPage.js — modal day-of-week toggles use index 0..6 mapped M..S, which matches Python `datetime.weekday()` (0=Mon). Good consistency.
PromotionDetailPage tabs: 'trend' (daily-trend), 'leaderboard', 'feed' all have testids. No accessibility role attributes on the tab buttons — recommend role='tab' + aria-selected for screen readers.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs reported by the user. Single latent backend defect identified by code review (async-for on Motor distinct()); reproduction would require running the notifier loop past a promo opening event in SAST (caught by broad exception handler so the loop continues, but no notifications get inserted).
